text:
Hannah P.: Quick sync: launching a 3-touch 'Onboarding Surge' drip for signups that hit onboarding but didn't finish. Goal = finish setup flow or book a quick orientation call. Window = 10 days.

Diego M.: segmentation plan? company_size, product_interest, and engagement_score?

Hannah P.: yes. three buckets: SMB (<=50), Mid (51-500), Enterprise (501+). product_interest token to tweak CTA line. engagement_score>50 get lighter touch.

Claire Z.: subject line candidates (will A/B):
- A: "Finish setup in 5 minutes — quick checklist"
- B: "Need help finishing your Redwood setup?"
We'll run A/B 50/50 across Mid+Enterprise, SMB gets A only (fewer variants).

Diego M.: cadence draft:
T+0: checklist + one-click button to finish (day 0)
T+3: short customer quote + scheduler CTA (day 3)
T+9: last nudge + small credit offer for SMBs (day 9)
send window: 10am recipient local time, rolling 48h for throttle.

Hannah P.: also include a parallel SMS nudge for contacts with phone && consent=true: single line with short link (tiny.cc). SMS only if email unopened after 48h.

Ben (crm-bot): will add suppression rule: if contact property `setup_completed=true` OR `booked_onboarding=true` -> suppress remaining emails/SMS. I will also push events: `surge_sent`, `surge_clicked`, `setup_completed`.

Asha L.: creative asks: simple hero with checklist bullets, personalization: first_name and company_size line. For Enterprise, add copy: "Enterprise onboarding specialist available". For SMB, highlight credit offer.

Diego M.: tracking UTMs: utm_source=onboard_surge, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=onboard_surge_1714, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. SMS links should include utm_source=sms_onboard.

Claire Z.: small experiment: for 10% of Enterprise segment, replace checklist with short product video (20s). Measure click-to-book differences.

Hannah P.: good idea. A/B cell = 10% video, 90% checklist in Enterprise.

Ben (crm-bot): note on routing: if user books via scheduler we set `booked_onboarding=true` and call endpoint /webhook/onboard-booked. Also mark lead_score += 20 for Enterprise, +=10 for Mid, +=5 for SMB.

Asha L.: deliverability: include List-Unsubscribe and plain-text. For SMS, abide by consent flag and opt-out keywords. We'll run seed inbox tests + carrier checks.

Diego M.: sample sizes: estimated eligible = 980 (SMB 420, Mid 310, Enterprise 250). With 50/50 A/B in Mid+Enterprise gives ~280/variant combined. Good to detect moderate lifts.

Claire Z.: content asset checklist: 3 subject variants, 3 body templates, hero images (SMB/Mid/Enterprise), 20s product clip for Enterprise cell, SMS copy. I'll upload files to shared drive by 3pm PT.

Hannah P.: CRM mapping: ensure custom_field `onboard_flow_stage` exists and that `utm_content` recorded. Ben, can you confirm mapping?

Ben (crm-bot): confirmed. Also will append property `surge_variant={variant}` for analysis. Draft campaign id saved: onboard-surge-1714 (draft).

Diego M.: tiny note on legal: SMB credit needs approval. Make alternative copy: "Request a 1:1 to discuss credits" if not approved. Keep both variants ready.

Asha L.: preflight: seeds + spam-scan 12h before. For SMS, test carrier delivery for US/UK/AU seeds. I'll run checks and post results.

Hannah P.: timeline: assets by EOD, preflight Tue 12pm PT, launch Thu 10am PT. Thanks all 44d. We'll review metrics 48h after send and iterate.
